title: 桜花賞の後に・重なる、あの日

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immediately following the Oka Sho, the overwhelming cheers of the crowd pull Mejiro Dober into a traumatizing flashback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suppressing her tremors the best she can, Mejiro Dober continues to desperately train for the Japanese Oaks. I can tell something is off though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, having noticed the change in Mejiro Dober's behavior, Air Groove asks me if she can talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clueless as to how I can help Mejiro Dober myself, I give Air Groove my permission.
